dct_description_sm: Balloon launches are carried out at least once per day to provide continuous physical sampling of the troposphere.  Balloon launches are also used to profile low-pressure systems, cyclones, and periods of significant warm or cold-air advection aloft.  Radiosonde data provides a high-frequency sample of atmospheric temperature, humidity, wind speed and direction, and geopotential height.  This data is also used to validate the performance of our ship-based Microwave Atmospheric Profiling Radiometer (MWRP).
dct_title_s: Rawinsonde Atmospheric Profiles - 2010 ArcticNet - Southern Beaufort Sea and Northwest Passage
